newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KGHM to invest $54 mln in Congo mining.
newsitem.headline: Polish KGHM to invest $54 mln in Congo mining.

text.p: Poland's KGHM Polska Miedz SA copper concern, due to start trading on the Warsaw and London bourses on July 10, will invest $54 million in the exploitation of cobalt and copper deposits in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (formerly Zaire), KGHM said in a prospectus.
It would invest $19 million in the project this year.
KGHM also said the company was eyeing additional investment in other African countries as well as India and China.

KGHM President Stanislaw Siewierski told a news conference on Friday the administration of the Congo's new president Laurent Kabila had said it would honour agreements with foreign investors signed by ousted president Mobutu Sese Seko.
KGHM had received a licence to exploit deposits in Zaire under an accord with state-owned Gecamines in 1996 when Mobutu was still in power.
